mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_setting (key, value, value_type, description) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}, #{valueType}, #{description}) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT key, value, value_type, description, created_at, updated_at FROM system_setting ORDER BY key ASC
